title: Tailwise Training Admission Chart by Course
content:
Admission to a Tailwise Training course turns on the dog's age at the first session, any course that must come first, the vaccinations the course needs, the behaviour flags the course accepts, the age above which an intact dog is not admitted to a group class, and the enrollment cutoff ahead of the first session. Every Tailwise Training course and pack is for dogs.

## Age and prerequisite

| Course or pack | Youngest age at first session | Oldest age at first session | Course that must be completed first (or waived by a passed trainer evaluation) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 10 weeks | 20 weeks | None |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 21 weeks | No limit (0) | None |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 21 weeks | No limit (0) | Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 21 weeks | No limit (0) | Intermediate Training 6-Week Group |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 10 weeks | No limit (0) | None |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 10 weeks | No limit (0) | None |

An oldest age of 0 means the course sets no upper age limit.

## Health and behaviour

| Course or pack | Current rabies certificate (dogs 16 weeks or older at first session) | Current DHPP or age-appropriate puppy series | Current bordetella | Behaviour flags accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Required | Required | Required | No flag |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | Required | Required | Required | No flag |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | Required | Required | Required | No flag |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Required | Required | Required | No flag |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | Required | Not required | Not required | No flag; handling caution; muzzle required |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | Required | Not required | Not required | No flag; handling caution; muzzle required |

## Intact dogs and enrollment cutoff

| Course or pack | Intact (unspayed or unneutered) dog age above which the dog is not admitted to group classes | Enrollment closes this many calendar days before the first session |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | No limit (0) | 1 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 12 months | 1 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 12 months | 1 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 12 months | 2 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | No limit (0) | 0 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | No limit (0) | 0 |

An intact-dog figure of 0 means no age limit applies on that course.

## Notes on the chart

- A dog flagged handling caution or muzzle required appears only under the two Private Training packs; the four group courses accept only dogs with no behaviour flag.
- The Intermediate Training 6-Week Group follows the Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group, and the Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group follows the Intermediate Training 6-Week Group; in each case a passed trainer evaluation takes the place of the earlier course.
- The puppy course window runs from 10 weeks to 20 weeks at the first session, and the adult group courses begin at 21 weeks.
